summary: Mayfair Gold Corp. filed a Form 6-K with a Q2 2026 operational update for its Fenn-Gib Gold Project. The report details progress on engineering design, grade control drilling, environmental studies, permitting, infrastructure, exploration, and capital markets engagement. No merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private, activist campaign, strategic review, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change is announced. The filing is a routine progress update on project advancement, not a special situation.
